title: HR Administrator
description:

You will demonstrate:
- Experience within Employee Relations or HR Administration
- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong written communication skills, including note-taking and minute-taking
- Excellent organisational and time management abilities
- Experience handling sensitive and confidential information
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- A professional, adaptable and resilient approach
- Confidence building relationships with stakeholders at all levels
- The ability to work independently and use initiative

Apply Now

title: Accounts Assistant
company: Three Bridges Recruitment LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Three Bridges Recruitment is working with a leading not-for-profit organisation in Edinburgh who are looking for an Accounts Assistant to support day-to-day donation processing and frontline customer service. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with basic finance experience who is looking to grow their skills within a supportive, values-led environment.

Why work here?

This organisation has a strong social mission and a deep community presence. People join because they want to contribute to meaningful work and stay because the environment is warm, steady and collaborative. You'll benefit from:
- Salary of £27,000
- 36 days' annual leave (pro-rata during the temporary period)
- Hybrid working after probation
- Flexible start and finish times
- A supportive and friendly team
- Regular social events and a culture grounded in care and purpose

This is a fantastic role for someone early in their finance career who wants to develop their skills while contributing to work with genuine impact.

Job

As Accounts Assistant, you'll sit within a finance team of five and work closely with colleagues across the organisation. Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing donations and payments with accuracy and care
- Managing weekly payment runs for approval
- Reviewing purchase ledger statements and carrying out reconciliations
- Resolving queries in a warm, empathetic and professional manner
- Creating and updating database records
- Supporting administrative tasks including preparing letters and stakeholder communication
- Handling financial transaction processing
- Assisting the wider team with finance queries
- Filing, scanning and general administration

You will begin primarily office-based in Edinburgh, receiving close support as you settle in, with the option to transition to hybrid working after probation.

This is a 6-month temporary role with genuine potential to become permanent.

You

As an Accounts Assistant, you will bring:
- Strong communication skills and a high degree of empathy
- A genuine desire to develop within a finance role
- Basic finance experience and/or administration or customer service experience
- A positive, can-do approach
- Calmness under pressure and strong attention to detail
- Good organisational skills and time management
- Confident use of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel

You'll thrive here if you enjoy being part of a caring, values-driven team and take pride in delivering accurate, reliable work.

About the Organisation

This is a respected not-for-profit organisation with a long track record of supporting communities across Scotland. The culture is grounded, human and purpose-led. People work with care and commitment, and the finance team reflects those same values: detail-focused, reliable and service-oriented. Your work will support the organisation's ability to deliver its mission and maintain the services relied upon by individuals and families across the country.

Interested?

At Three Bridges Recruitment, two of our values are "striving for brilliance" and "relatability". We want every applicant to receive an excellent experience and to feel confident that this role is right for them.If this opportunity sounds like a good fit, please apply with your most up-to-date CV or contact us for a confidential discussion.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Temporary HR Assistant

£14.00 - £17.00 per hour DOE Immediate Start Hybrid Temporary, potential to go permanent

We are currently recruiting for a Temporary HR Assistant to join a busy HR team on an immediate basis.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced HR Assistant who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and is confident managing the detail behind busy people processes.

The role will provide essential administrative support to the HR team, with a particular focus on HR compliance, employee records, recruitment administration and data management.

The Role

You will be responsible for supporting the HR team with a range of day-to-day administrative activities, including:
- Maintaining accurate employee and HR records
- Supporting HR compliance and administration processes
- Assisting with recruitment administration and onboarding
- Managing and updating information within the organisation's ATS
- Completing high-volume data entry and ensuring information is accurate and up to date
- Preparing documentation and maintaining HR files
- Supporting the wider HR team with general administration
- Helping to keep HR processes running smoothly during a particularly busy period
- Providing ad-hoc administrative support across the wider People function

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, reliable and comfortable working at pace, with excellent attention to detail.

You'll ideally have previous experience within an HR administration or HR assistant role and be confident dealing with confidential information and a high volume of administrative tasks.

Experience of recruitment administration would be beneficial, but this is not a sourcing-focused recruitment role. The emphasis is on the administration, compliance and coordination that sits behind the recruitment and HR processes.

You'll also need to be comfortable learning new systems, as the business is implementing a new ATS and full training will be provided.

There is potential for the role to develop into a permanent opportunity for the right person

If you're an experienced HR Assistant who can hit the ground running and enjoys being the person who keeps everything organised behind the scenes, we'd love to hear from you.
